problems: e69: audio-plug ↔ audio-jack is not a compatible pair
notes: The manual gives no wiring diagram of its own (it embeds the generic rpi-gpio-wiring-a-button guide). I used the standard wiring: each button joins a GPIO pin to GND.
GPIO pins 4, 17, 27 and 10 come from the full code listing. The manual says any pins can be used.
Button leg placement is an assumption. Each button straddles the breadboard centre gap, with 1.l/1.r in the top half and 2.l/2.r in the bottom half. Columns are 2/4, 9/11, 16/18 and 23/25.
The pin-to-socket jumper ports are named 'socket' (on the Pi header) and 'pin' (in the breadboard). The jumper-wire-mf catalogue entry lists no ports.
The 5 pin-to-socket jumpers are 4 GPIO leads and 1 GND lead to the top negative rail. The 4 pin-to-pin jumpers run from the rail to the right-hand leg column of each button.
Speakers or headphones plug into the Pi's 3.5 mm audio jack, modelled as a new 'speaker' part.
Power, keyboard, monitor and the SD card are not modelled. The software steps (pygame, gpiozero, sample files) are not hardware parts.
